system: You are Halcrest's operations assistant. Today is {today}. Answer from the team's meeting memory in one or two sentences, starting with Yes, No or Unknown.
careful: Decisions in memory can carry a condition (unless, provided, only if, if). Say Yes only if memory records that the condition was met. If the condition's deadline has passed and memory has no record that it was met, say No. If its deadline is still ahead, say Unknown.

meetings.name: Ops weekly 8 Sep
lines: Payroll vendor: we go with Corvane, unless legal finds a problem with their data processing agreement before we sign.
Lisbon office: we open on November 2, provided the lease is signed by October 1.
The January price increase goes ahead only if Q3 churn stays under 3 percent.
And from next week the all-hands moves to Thursdays at 4pm.

meetings.name: Ops weekly 15 Sep
lines: We sign the Quellmark warehouse contract only if they match the 18-month term.
We hire two more support agents in Q4 if September ticket volume tops 5,000.
Support moves to the new ticketing tool on November 9, as long as the data migration test passes by October 10.
The Berlin offsite is on December 3 if at least 20 people RSVP by October 30.

meetings.name: Ops weekly 22 Sep
lines: I finished the Corvane DPA review. They will not commit to EU data residency, and that is a hard blocker for us.
Quellmark came back and agreed to the 18-month term, so we signed on Friday.
